gaps: No infrastructure of the interim storage itself: that sits in Tab. 11.7/11.8 (per unit of store) and its operation in Tab. 11.9/11.10; this conditioning dataset does not draw on them in the table as printed.

The dataset's includedProcesses mentions 'input of service from the final repository for low active level waste, i.e. the take over of the conditioned waste' - that is the 1.00 m3 of 'radioactive waste, in final repository for nuclear waste LLW' line.
No conditioning matrix (cement, bitumen) and no container material.

The compartment split (air, low population density for the first block; water, river for the second) is taken from the two footer lines of the table because the compartment column itself is not repeated on each row.
